name: Adroit Industries (India) Limited
about: Adroit Industries (India) Limited engages in the manufacturing of Propeller Shaft and its components including Universal Joint, Slip Yoke, Weld Yoke, End Yoke, Companion Flange & Flange Yoke, Tube, Stub Shaft. The company's products are used in commercial and passenger vehicles, such as cars, light / medium / heavy commercial vehicles, and several other industrial applications. Additionally, the company engages in manufacturing dyes for forging. The company exports its products internationally. It caters to various industries including automotive, marine, locomotive, and agriculture. Adroit Industries (India) Limited was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Indore, India.
